Class GradleProjectDetector

java.lang.Object
dev.copperbench.core.workspace.project.GradleProjectDetector
public final class GradleProjectDetector extends Object
Identifies a single-module Fabric or NeoForge Gradle project from its files (ADR-0020). It never runs Gradle, never writes, and reports an unsupported project instead of guessing a version from a range.
